language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the interface.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Pick the theme that matches your environment.

header.title: Engine
header.description: Advanced controls for the search to download to import pipeline. Defaults are tuned to a balanced sweet spot that works well for most setups, change them only if you know what you are doing. When in doubt, leave them as-is or hit Reset to defaults on the affected card if tracks start failing after a change.

maxPeerAttempts.label: Max peer attempts
maxPeerAttempts.description: How many slskd uploaders to try downloading from per track before marking it failed.

maxVariations.label: Max variations
maxVariations.description: How many query-string combinations (artist+title, with/without album, with/without featuring) to try per track.

historyCleanup.label: History cleanup enabled
historyCleanup.description: Hourly cron deletes old slskd searches so its search list does not grow unbounded.

maxHistorySearches.label: Max history searches
maxHistorySearches.description: How many of the most recent searches to retain in slskd. Older ones are removed by the cleanup job above.

autoBan.label: Auto-ban after N failures
autoBan.description: Add an uploader/peer to the banlist after this many download failures (counted in-memory, resets on restart). 0 disables.

strictTierOrdering.label: Strict quality tier ordering
strictTierOrdering.description: Always try lossless sources first, then high-bitrate lossy, then the rest. Within each tier the usual blended score still decides the order.

customMoodKeywords.label: Custom mood keywords
customMoodKeywords.helper: Substrings tested against user search queries to classify them as mood/genre searches (vs specific artist/track). Press Enter or comma to add.

searchPhase.label: Search phase
searchPhase.description: How long slskd keeps each search request open on the Soulseek network before stopping collection of new results.

downloadPhase.label: Download phase
downloadPhase.description: Total budget for the full download phase per track. The track is marked failed if this elapses.

importPhase.label: Import phase
importPhase.description: Total budget for the import phase per track. Marked failed if exceeded.

peerUnresponsive.label: Peer unresponsive
peerUnresponsive.description: Max time a download can sit in slskd's unresponsive states before we cancel and try the next peer.

queueWaitActivePeer.label: Queue wait (active peer)
queueWaitActivePeer.description: Max wait in slskd's Queued states when the peer is already actively serving another download to us (likely to give this one its turn).

queueWaitIdlePeer.label: Queue wait (idle peer)
queueWaitIdlePeer.description: Max wait in slskd's queued states when the peer is not currently serving us anything (may be offline or ignoring the request).

maxSize.label: Max size
maxSize.description: Hard cap on total jobs the queue holds at once (queued + active). New requests are rejected when full.

maxConcurrentSearches.label: Max concurrent searches
maxConcurrentSearches.description: How many tracks can be in the search phase simultaneously.

maxPendingImports.label: Max pending imports
maxPendingImports.description: Backpressure: when this many downloaded tracks are waiting to import, the engine pauses starting new searches until imports drain.

metadataConfidence.label: Metadata confidence threshold
metadataConfidence.description: Minimum match (0-100) between a downloaded file's embedded audio tags. Files below this score are rejected with and can be retried.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.description: Files that failed verification are remembered here, so a retry never downloads the same wrong file from the same source again.

identityGate.label: AcoustID identity gate
identityGate.description: Block the import when the audio fingerprint identifies a different song than the requested one. The file is quarantined and a retry looks for another candidate.

empty.title: No quarantined files
empty.description: When a downloaded file fails verification, the exact file and its source appear here and are skipped on retries.

confirmClear.title: Clear the quarantine?
confirmClear.message: All entries will be removed. Retries may download these exact files from the same sources again.

sourceTrust.title: Source trust
sourceTrust.manage: Banned uploaders and the auto-ban threshold are managed in the <slskd>Soulseek settings</slskd>.

autoBan.label: Auto-ban threshold
autoBan.description: Failed downloads before an uploader is banned automatically.

reviewQueue.hint: A rejected file is kept for you to judge. Open the <review>review queue</review> in Requests to approve or discard it.

wanted.title: Wanted sweep
wanted.description: Watches failed tracks and retries them periodically, spaced out by release age.

enabled.label: Enable wanted sweep
enabled.description: Periodically retry failed tracks that are being watched.

perRunCap.label: Tracks per sweep
perRunCap.description: Maximum number of watched tracks retried on each sweep run.

maxAttempts.label: Max sweep attempts
maxAttempts.description: Stop watching a track after this many unsuccessful sweep retries.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Upgrade already-downloaded tracks in place when you explicitly request a better copy.

upgradeEnabled.label: Allow quality upgrades
upgradeEnabled.description: An explicit re-request can replace an owned file when the new copy is strictly better.

retentionDays.label: Retention period
retentionDays.description: How many days replaced files stay in the recycle bin before cleanup.

status.loadError: Failed to load recycle bin status

size.label: Total size
size.description: Disk space currently used by the recycle bin.

entries.label: Files
entries.description: Replaced files currently kept in the recycle bin.

oldest.label: Oldest entry
oldest.description: Date of the oldest recycled file.

empty.confirmMessage: All replaced files kept in the recycle bin will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

enrichment.title: Metadata Enrichment
enrichment.description: External services that enrich your library with artwork, fingerprinting fallbacks, and tagging data. All optional but recommended, leave empty to fall back to public defaults or skip the feature.

musicbrainzEmail.label: MusicBrainz contact email
musicbrainzEmail.helper: Required. Without it, Synthseek shares rate-limited email.

acoustidKey.label: AcoustID API key
acoustidKey.helper: Audio fingerprinting fallback for tracks without reliable tag metadata.

librarySources.title: Library Sources
librarySources.description: Streaming platforms that Synthseek can import playlists and saved albums from.

songlinkKey.label: Songlink API key (optional)
songlinkKey.helper: Resolves track URLs across platforms for cross-platform playlist imports. Synthseek uses the public endpoint by default. Leave blank unless you have a key.

spotify.title: Spotify
spotify.subtitle: Developer's app configuration
spotify.redirectUriHelper: Paste this URI exactly into your Spotify App's 'Redirect URIs' list.
spotify.validationMissingFields: Spotify is enabled but missing required fields. Fill in Client ID and Public Base URL, or disable the toggle.

spotifyRequirements.title: Spotify Development Mode requirements
spotifyRequirements.ownerPremium: The Spotify account that owns the app in the Developer Dashboard must have an active Premium subscription.
spotifyRequirements.userManagement: Every Synthseek user who wants to connect must be added to the app's Settings → User Management list (using their Spotify email).
spotifyRequirements.connectorsNoPremium: Connecting users do not need Premium themselves, only the app owner does.

serverUrl.label: Server URL
serverUrl.helperConnected: Detected via OAuth. Edit by reconnecting.
serverUrl.helperDisconnected: Click Reconnect to link a Plex server.

serverPicker.prompt: Pick the Plex server Synthseek should target:
serverPicker.empty: No servers found on this Plex account.

libraryScan.label: Media server rescan
libraryScan.description: After each successful import, ask Plex to scan the folder of the new file.

playlistSync.label: Playlist sync
playlistSync.description: When a Synthseek playlist request completes (or grows), create / update a matching Plex playlist with the imported tracks.

usernameAffix.label: Username affix
usernameAffix.description: Prefix or suffix Plex playlist names with the requester's username so multi-user playlists do not collide.

separator.label: Separator
separator.helper: Character(s) between the name and username. Common: _, -, ·

bannedUploaders.label: Banned uploaders
bannedUploaders.helper: Skip these slskd users/peers when picking download candidates. <threshold>Configure threshold</threshold>
bannedUploaders.tooltipWhat: Soulseek usernames added here are blocked as download sources. Synthseek skips their files and downloads from another source instead. Add anyone who keeps sending bad files or failing to deliver.
bannedUploaders.tooltipAuto: Synthseek can also add uploaders here for you. When a user's transfers fail too many times in a row they are banned automatically. Only real transfer failures count, not filename mismatches, and the limit is configured in Engine > Search (set it to 0 to turn auto-ban off).

lidarr.title: Lidarr
lidarr.description: Optional. Hand off albums to an existing Lidarr instance.

ytdlp.title: yt-dlp
ytdlp.description: Fallback source used when slskd cannot deliver a track. Format and quality follow each request's own config.

enable.label: Enable
enable.description: When on, tracks that fail on higher-priority sources are retried via yt-dlp within the same job.

searchResults.label: Search results
searchResults.description: How many YouTube candidates to fetch per track before scoring by duration and title.

maxDurationDelta.label: Max duration delta
maxDurationDelta.description: Reject candidates whose length differs from the expected track by more than this many seconds.

searchTimeout.label: Search timeout
searchTimeout.description: How long yt-dlp can spend searching YouTube for a track. YouTube search is slower than slskd, so it gets a wider default.

members.cardDescription: Users that share this Synthseek instance.

bulk.deleteMessage: This removes the selected accounts and reassigns their request history to the owner. Downloaded files in Plex are not affected.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.message: Delete {{username}}? This removes the user account and reassigns their request history to the owner. Downloaded files in Plex are not affected.

create.title: Create local user
create.description: Local users sign in with their email and password.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.description: Update this member's details. Leave the password blank to keep it unchanged.
edit.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current password
edit.ownerRoleNote: The owner account must stay an admin.

import.title: Import Plex users
import.empty: No Plex users with access to this server were found.

roleDescriptions.trusted: Trusted members' requests skip the approval queue.

approval.cardDescription: Control whether member requests need an admin's approval before they start.

requireForMembers.label: Require approval for members
requireForMembers.description: New requests from members wait for an admin. Trusted members and admins skip the queue.

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.emailManagedByPlex: Your email is managed by Plex.

password.title: Password
password.managedByPlex: Your password is managed by Plex.

connected.title: Connected accounts
connected.empty: No connected sources are available right now.

spotify.name: Spotify
spotify.notConfigured: Ask an admin to configure Spotify first.

plex.name: Plex
plex.needsPassword: Set a password before unlinking, otherwise you would be locked out.

keys.title: API Keys
keys.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to connect an app or assistant.
keys.description: For scripts, and for assistants that cannot use OAuth.

create.title: Create API key
create.description: Give it a name so you can recognize it later (for example, the device or app it lives on).
create.revealWarning: Copy it now. For your security, you will not be able to see it again.

revoke.title: Revoke API key
revoke.message: Any assistant using this key will immediately lose access. This cannot be undone.

mcp.title: AI assistants
mcp.description: Connect an AI assistant to Synthseek over the Model Context Protocol.
mcp.endpointHelper: Add this URL as a custom connector or MCP server in your assistant.
mcp.oauthBody: For claude.ai web and native connectors. Add the endpoint as a custom connector and sign in with your Synthseek account. No key needed, and access follows your role.
mcp.keyBody: For Claude Code, Cursor, or Claude Desktop (via mcp-remote). Create a key above and send it as the bearer token: Authorization: Bearer <your key>.
mcp.toolsDescription: What a connected assistant can do: search the catalog, queue and manage downloads, browse your library, read and update settings, and (for admins) control the queue, trigger jobs, check system health, and read server logs for diagnostics. Exact availability depends on your role.

tools.discovery: Discovery: search_music, get_music_details, get_artist_overview, get_trending, browse_genres, get_recommendations, resolve_url
tools.downloads: Downloads: download_track, download_album, download_playlist, retry_request, cancel_request, retry_all_failed
tools.operations: Operations (admin): get_queue_stats, pause_queue, resume_queue, trigger_job, get_system_health, and read server logs for diagnostics (list_log_files, read_logs)

page.title: Logs
page.description: Recent server logs in the same format as the console. Filter by level, search, copy, or export.

viewer.title: Logs
viewer.description: The most recent lines from the active log file.

export.title: Export all logs
export.description: Bundle all server log files into a single zip.

page.title: Updates
page.description: See your current version, check for new releases, and browse patch notes for every version.

version.title: Current version
version.description: The version of Synthseek this instance is currently running.

check.title: Check for updates
check.description: Look for a newer release published to the container registry.
check.unknown: Could not check for updates right now
check.upToDate: You are on the latest version

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.description: Browse the release notes for each version.
notes.empty: Patch notes are not available right now.

page.title: Jobs
page.description: Background tasks Synthseek runs on a schedule. Trigger any job to run it immediately.

card.title: Scheduled jobs
card.description: Each job shows its schedule and next run. Press play to run it now.

library-sync.name: External Library Sync
library-sync.description: Imports tracks from connected external libraries.

discovery-sweep.name: Discovery Sweep
discovery-sweep.description: Evaluates discovery feeds and triggers integrations.

media-server-sync.name: Media Server Sync
media-server-sync.description: Keeps your media server's playlists in sync.

wanted-sweep.name: Wanted Sweep
wanted-sweep.description: Retries watched failed tracks on a release-age schedule.

usenet-staging-sweep.name: Usenet Staging Sweep
usenet-staging-sweep.description: Removes downloaded Usenet albums nobody asked another track from.

library-scan.name: Library Scan
library-scan.description: Indexes the audio files on disk, works out what each one holds, and reconciles what disappeared.

accessDenied.title: Restricted
accessDenied.message: Only administrators can access this section.

usenet.title: Usenet
usenet.description: Second acquisition source. Usenet publishes whole releases, so a request pulls the full album and takes the track it needs from it.

enable.label: Enable
enable.description: When on, album requests can be served from Usenet through your indexer and SABnzbd.

maxSize.label: Maximum release size
maxSize.description: Skip any release larger than this. Set to 0 to accept any size.

minAge.label: Minimum release age
minAge.description: Skip releases newer than this, since a very recent post may still be spreading across servers and would arrive incomplete.

singleTrackRequests.title: Single-track requests
singleTrackRequests.label: Use Usenet outside albums too
singleTrackRequests.description: Off by default. When off, Usenet is only offered for album requests.
singleTrackRequests.tooltipWhat: Usenet never publishes single tracks, only whole releases. Getting one song means downloading the entire album it belongs to.
singleTrackRequests.tooltipCost: The downloaded album is kept for a while in case another of its tracks is requested, then deleted. Turning this on trades disk space and bandwidth for finding songs that no peer is sharing.

stagingRetention.label: Keep unused albums for
stagingRetention.description: How long a downloaded album waits for another of its tracks to be requested before it is deleted.
stagingRetention.ariaLabel: Keep unused albums for this many hours

stagedList.title: Albums waiting

empty.title: Nothing waiting
empty.description: Albums downloaded for a single track appear here until they expire.

stagedList.loadError: Could not load the waiting albums

confirmClear.title: Delete every waiting album?
confirmClear.message: The downloaded folders are removed from disk. Any track requested from them later will download the album again.

subsonic.title: Music players
subsonic.description: Listen to your library in Feishin, DSub, Symfonium and other Subsonic apps.

connect.passwordHelper: The password is the credential you create below.

coverage.line: {{streamable}} tracks with a recorded file · {{missing}} without one

disabled.admin: Turn this on to let music apps reach your library.
disabled.member: An admin has not turned this on yet.

create.title: New music-app credential
create.description: Use it as the password in any Subsonic client.
create.revealDescription: Use your Synthseek username with this as the password.
create.revealWarning: This is the only time it is shown.

revoke.title: Revoke credential
revoke.message: The app using it will stop connecting immediately.

rotation.title: {{count}} credential(s) can no longer be read and must be recreated. This happens when AUTH_SECRET changes.

transcoding.label: Convert on the fly
transcoding.description: Send a smaller stream when an app asks for one. Costs processing time while it plays.

card.title: Connect apps
card.description: Apps and assistants that connect to your Synthseek.

card.title: Library scan
card.description: What Synthseek can see on disk, and what it cannot.

run.never: This library has never been scanned.

dirtyWalk.title: The scan could not read everything
dirtyWalk.body_one: {{count}} path could not be read. Everything under it keeps the state it had, and the rest of the library was reconciled normally. Fix the permissions and scan again.
dirtyWalk.body_other: {{count}} paths could not be read. Everything under them keeps the state it had, and the rest of the library was reconciled normally. Fix the permissions and scan again.

duplicates.title: Duplicated tracks
duplicates.description: Tracks your library holds more than once. Keeping the best copy moves the rest to the recycle bin, where they stay recoverable.
duplicates.summary: {{count}} track(s) held more than once, {{size}} recoverable
duplicates.ambiguous: copies do not match, left for you
duplicates.ambiguousHint: The copies carry different titles, so one may be a different recording. Resolve this one yourself.
duplicates.tidyAll: Keep the best of every track
duplicates.tidySkipped: Left that track alone, its copies do not match
duplicates.emptyBody: Every track in your library is held exactly once.
duplicates.discarded: Copy moved to the recycle bin
duplicates.confirmBody: {{path}} goes to the recycle bin. Your library keeps playing {{keep}}.
